tasks.title: Free-space path loss
tasks.statement: Distance **{d} km**, frequency **{f} MHz**. Find the FSPL (dB).
tasks.solution: FSPL = 20·lg(d_km) + 20·lg(f_MHz) + 32.44. Doubling the distance or the frequency adds +6 dB.

tasks.title: Link margin
tasks.statement: Transmitter **{p} dBm**, antennas **{g} dBi** on both ends, FSPL **{l} dB**, receiver sensitivity **−{s} dBm**. Find the margin (dB).
tasks.solution: Margin = P_tx + G_tx + G_rx − FSPL − S_rx (the sensitivity is negative, so we add its absolute value). A working margin is no less than 15–20 dB for fading.

tasks.title: Fresnel zone
tasks.statement: A **{d} km** link at **{f} GHz**. Find the radius of the first Fresnel zone at the midpoint of the path (m).
tasks.solution: r₁ = 17.32·√(d_km/(4·f_GHz)) at the midpoint of the path. 60% of this radius must be clear of obstacles.
